faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the BMC Treatment Organizer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) under the Public Health Department Tuberculosis Control Department for hiring eligible candidates across Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Treatment Organizer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies available for the Treatment Organizer position under this recruitment notification numbered MGC/F/6962.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the BMC Treatment Organizer role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Treatment Organizer post will receive a fixed consolidated salary of Rs. 17,000/- per month throughout their contract tenure.

faq.question: Q4. What are the start and last dates to apply for BMC Treatment Organizer 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 11 September 2026, and the final date to submit the application along with necessary documents is 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum and maximum age limit required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Treatment Organizer post must be at least 18 years old and not more than 43 years old as per the notification criteria.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc degree or an H.S.C qualification with specific healthcare experience, health courses, or sanitation diplomas, along with computer certifications and Marathi/English in 10th grade.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the BMC Treatment Organizer examination?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online form or hard copies for the Treatment Organizer recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BMC Treatment Organizer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes online Google Form submission, hard copy document submission, academic merit weightage, and bonus marks for prior experience.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the BMC Treatment Organizer position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to fill out the online Google Form via the provided link and submit a physical printout with self-attested documents to the department.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF directly from the Important Links table section provided in this recruitment article by clicking the link.
